name: TNFR1-driven canonical NF-kB activation and linear ubiquitination
rationale: All members concern TNFR1 signaling and positive canonical NF-kB activation (with LUBAC linear ubiquitination), unlike confusables built on RIP1/IRAK1 IKK recruitment, negative TNF/necroptosis regulation, or noncanonical NF-kB.

name: LDL receptor family internalization and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members cover endocytic internalization and lysosomal catabolism of receptors, chiefly LDLR/VLDLR clearance, whereas confusables emphasize cholesterol import, cell-surface localization, triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance or sterol sensing.

qualifier: MVB sorting, abscission, nuclear envelope sealing and viral budding
name: ESCRT membrane scission in MVB sorting, abscission and budding
rationale: Members are ESCRT-dependent membrane fission events (MVB/receptor downregulation, midbody abscission, nuclear envelope resealing, exosome and viral budding), distinct from autophagy, contractile-ring cytokinesis and ERBB downregulation confusables.

qualifier: regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake and carnitine shuttle
name: Regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members regulate long-chain fatty acid import and mitochondrial beta-oxidation via the carnitine shuttle, unlike confusables on lipid droplet/triglyceride storage or carnitine transport and medium-chain metabolism.

core: Antimicrobial host defense against bacteria and fungi
name: Antimicrobial peptides and neutrophil granule defense against microbes
rationale: Members describe direct antimicrobial killing at mucosa and by neutrophils (defensins, granule proteins, metal sequestration, responses to bacteria and fungi), as opposed to complement, respiratory burst or macrophage activation confusables.

core: Renal salt and cell volume homeostasis
qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and osmotic stress responses
name: Cation-chloride cotransport in salt, osmotic and volume homeostasis
rationale: Members span Na/K/Cl transport by SLC12 cotransporters, renal sodium handling and hyper/hypo-osmotic responses, distinguishing them from confusables centred on vasopressin-aquaporin water handling, Na/H exchangers or potassium channels.

qualifier: extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis, PLC activation
name: Purinergic GPCR signaling and extracellular ATP turnover
rationale: Members center on P2Y/adenosine receptor signaling, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis with PLC-IP3-calcium coupling, unlike confusables on generic calcium elevation, Wnt-calcium or eicosanoid receptors.

qualifier: anergy and inhibition of T cell proliferation
name: Peripheral T cell tolerance, anergy and inhibited T cell proliferation
rationale: Most members concern self-tolerance induction, anergy, Treg differentiation and suppression of T cell proliferation and IFN-gamma, whereas confusables cover Th1 differentiation, NK/T activation or broad cytokine suppression.

name: Zinc ion import and intracellular zinc homeostasis
rationale: All three members concern zinc uptake and intracellular zinc balance, distinct from copper/manganese transport, metallothionein responses and heavy-metal detoxification confusables.

name: Acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE, PS and PI
rationale: Members are Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling of the major glycerophospholipids, whereas confusables cover de novo phospholipid synthesis, cardiolipin, PA/DAG/TAG and phospholipid catabolism.

name: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside catabolism
rationale: All members describe degradation of glycosphingolipids/gangliosides, unlike confusables on their biosynthesis and transport or on glycosaminoglycan and amino-sugar catabolism.

name: Platelet activation, granule secretion and cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members cover platelet activation and degranulation with SNARE disinhibition and integrin-actin cytoskeletal remodeling, distinct from VWF adhesion, platelet receptor agonist signaling and Rho/Rap integrin signaling confusables.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transition transcription program
rationale: Members are E2F target and G1/S-specific transcription signatures promoting G1/S, unlike confusables on G2/M checkpoints, DNA replication initiation or RB/CDK regulatory mechanics.

name: Phosphate and bicarbonate transport, organelle acidification, tooth mineralization
rationale: Members combine SLC phosphate and bicarbonate transporters and their disorders, organelle pH regulation and enamel/dentin mineralization, unlike confusables on FGF23/bone mineralization or SLC26 anion exchange.

qualifier: atrophy and growth in response to activity and inactivity
name: Skeletal muscle mass adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle atrophy, growth, cell size and regeneration in response to use and disuse, whereas confusables cover calcineurin-NFAT signaling or cardiac muscle adaptation and fiber-type switching.

qualifier: cAMP modulation, calcium influx and gap junctions
name: Neuron-glia signaling via cAMP, calcium influx and gap junctions
rationale: Members loosely share intercellular neural-glial communication through adenylate cyclase modulation, calcium entry and gap junction coupling; gap junctions and neuron-glia signaling distinguish it from Gi-coupled glutamate and adrenergic confusables.

name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix and EMT gene program
rationale: Members are ECM, collagen/TGF-beta and EMT signatures with focal adhesion and YAP/TAZ mechanoresponse, versus confusables on stromal fibroblast/complement, integrin binding or fibronectin-driven migration.

qualifier: CNTF and IL-11 receptors, autocrine/paracrine STAT signaling
name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling via CNTF and IL-11 receptors
rationale: Members center on gp130 cytokine signaling (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM) through STAT with autocrine/paracrine inflammatory output, distinguished from IL-6/LIF-only, IL-10/IL-27 and broad interleukin confusables by CNTF and IL-11.

qualifier: structural proteins of coronavirus, RSV and dengue
name: Post-translational maturation of viral structural proteins
rationale: All members describe processing and maturation of viral structural proteins before assembly, whereas confusables cover viral attachment, entry, release and host-pathway targeting.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription and translation steps and small ribosomal subunit assembly, whereas confusables emphasize mitochondrial RNA processing, stability, modification and DNA replication.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration, ATP synthesis and ROS output
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis and ROS production, unlike confusables on oxidative stress-induced cell death, ferroptosis or drug/hypoxia responses.

qualifier: nephron patterning up to S-shaped body
name: Early kidney patterning and nephron morphogenesis to S-shaped body
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct/ureter and early nephron stages (renal vesicle, comma and S-shaped bodies), unlike confusables on distal tubule/collecting duct development or mesenchymal-epithelial transition.

name: V-ATPase-driven lysosomal and Golgi lumen pH regulation
rationale: All members concern lysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification and V-ATPase assembly, distinct from endosomal/synaptic vesicle Na/H exchange and plasma membrane anion transport confusables.

name: Polyamine biosynthesis, interconversion and transport
rationale: All members concern putrescine, spermidine and spermine synthesis, oxidation and transport, unlike confusables on methionine salvage, hypusine modification or ornithine/arginine metabolism.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte hypertrophy and maturation
rationale: All members concern hypertrophic maturation of growth plate chondrocytes, unlike confusables on osteoblast development, bone mineralization or early chondrocyte differentiation.
